plugins.name: mcp-gtags-server
plugins.description: Indexed C/C++ code navigation for coding agents, powered by GNU Global (gtags): who calls a function (with each call site's source line), every usage grouped by file, call chains, and definitions with their #ifdef guard stacks — filterable by a real kernel .config. Resolves macro-generated kernel symbols (sys_read to its SYSCALL_DEFINE3 site). No build, no compile_commands.json, no sudo: the toolchain installs itself on first use and scales to the 37M-line Linux kernel.
